capabilities: search Légifrance databases (jurisprudence, codes, legislation, Journal officiel) and read texts in a built-in reader
create decision and article notes from Légifrance data using customizable Handlebars templates
detect legal references cited in notes and list them with links in a side panel
maintain a SQLite database of which notes cite which legal texts, with full texts and validity status
export tables of decisions and bibliographies as Markdown, CSV, BibTeX or RIS
extras: Works without PISTE credentials in a reduced mode (reference detection, panel, indexing, opening legifrance.gouv.fr in the browser); credentials unlock exact links, validity status, decision completion and article notes. Requires Obsidian 1.13.2 or later. Credentials are stored in Obsidian's secret storage, not data.json. The README includes a disclosure section on network access and a note that the plugin itself contains no AI features even though it was developed with Claude Code.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search French legal databases, consult court decisions and statutes, or track the legal references cited across a vault.
